name: Passkey MFA Authentication Handler
summary: Binds Passkey step-up proof to the durable UserId carried by a password-issued MFA challenge, consumes that MFA challenge only after WebAuthn proof succeeds, and returns the proven AppUser for session-specific completion.
notes: BeginAsync validates provider=passkey and starts the user-bound WebAuthn ceremony for the challenge UserId with step-up user verification required.
CompleteAsync validates the same MFA challenge, completes the real user-bound Passkey proof, consumes the MFA challenge only after proof succeeds, and resolves the proven AppUser by challenge UserId.

sourceReferences.note: Real Passkey manager verifies challenge ownership, credential ownership, WebAuthn assertion, signature counter and MFA freshness.
